title: Owner UI Capability Exposure Matrix
method: Evidence-first. Each capability is classified by tracing whether a real owner page/component/API renders it and exposes the correct action + safety boundaries. A capability is owner-visible ONLY if a page shows it; backend or API existence alone is NOT owner-visible.
keyFinding: The `owner/process-intelligence` page is a real governed cockpit: it renders one top process breakdown + the governed execution route (ProcessExecutionBridgePanel) wired to POST /api/owner/process-execution (applyProcessExecutionAction), plus progressive-disclosure panels for ~10 proven capabilities — all fed by ONE payload (GET /api/owner/now-view → getOwnerNowView). The newest PASS 28-33 pipeline (public-signal-*, business-survival-recovery, recovery-milestone-execution, owner-cockpit-decision-explanation) is proven-by-tests but reaches NO page and NO served endpoint.

summary.correctionToPass34: PASS 34 said '0 of 35 owner-visible in UI'. That is too strong: 17 of the 32 audited capabilities are owner-visible (8 actionable, 6 read-only, 3 partial) via the existing owner pages — chiefly owner/process-intelligence fed by /api/owner/now-view. The accurate gap is: (a) no single canonical minimum cockpit meeting the full safety-section spec, and (b) the newest PASS 28-33 proven pipeline (public-signal-*, survival, recovery-milestone, cockpit-explanation module) is unwired with no served endpoint. Note: PASS 34's matrix assessed 35 named MODULES (different granularity); this audit assesses 32 owner-journey CAPABILITIES.
